 🌃 WELCOME TO SOUTHSIDE CHICAGO 3 🌃

Welcome to Southside Chicago 3 (SSC3) — a realistic, open-world hood roleplay experience inspired by the streets of Chicago. 🩸

💰 Make money, build your reputation, and make a name for yourself.
Whether you're chasing the bag, cruising through the city, or running the streets with your crew, your story is yours to create.

🔥 FEATURES:
- 🏙️ Detailed Chicago-inspired city & interiors
- 🏎️ Realistic cars & vehicle customization
- 🔫 Custom weapons & gun customization
- 💵 Street hustles, jobs & ways to earn cash
- 🏦 Banks, businesses & locations to explore
- 🏠 Neighborhoods, apartments & hangout spots
- 🛠️ Frequent updates & new content

⚠️ RULES:
- 🚫 No Exploiting or Glitching
- 🚫 No Random Killing
- ✅ Respect Other Players & Roleplay Fairly

⭐ Like & Favorite the game to support development and stay updated with new releases!
